question: The Computer Technology is based on which of the following scientific principals?

options.text: Light amplification by stimulated emission of radiation

solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Digital logic**__**.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Computer Technology is based on Digital logic principles.**
 
• **Digital logic**__
 __
 
• It is the **combination of binary values through printed circuit board technology.**
 
• It uses circuits and logic gates to build the implementation of computer operations.
 
 
 
• The main component of digital logic consists of five different logic gates:
 
 
• **AND**
 
• **OR**
 
• **XOR**
 
• **NAND**
 
• **NOR​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Superconductivity**__

 __
 
• It is a state of matter that has **no electrical resistance and does not allow a magnetic field to enter.**
 
• Electric current can persist indefinitely in a superconductor. i.e there is no loss of electricity. 
 
• Below **critical temperature, aluminum, niobium, and magnesium diboride become superconductors.**
 
• Superconductivity can usually be **achieved at very cold temperatures.**
 
 
 
• **Photoelectric effect**__
 
 
• It is the **emission of electrons when electromagnetic radiation, such as light, hits a material.**
 
• It was discovered by **Heinrich Hertz** in the year 1887.
